_about: Blog queue for vendingpreneurs.com news. Source: reports/content-funnel-2026-10-18/CONTENT-FUNNEL-PLAN.md (volumes are US monthly, DataForSEO 2026-10-18). The drafter takes the first 'queued' topic whose slug has no news_posts row yet. 'vendhub' = owned by the VendHub blog (default split 2026-11-13: VP owns profit/worth-it, business plan, coaching, financing; VendHub owns machines, contracts, licenses, locations data). Volumes from the seo_keywords table and Search Console (seo_gsc_query_daily).
